']; let i=0; const img=document.getElementById('img'), count=document.getElementById('count'), prev=document.getElementById('prev'), next=document.getElementById('next');
function show(){img.src=pages[i]; count.textContent=(i+1)+' / '+pages.length; prev.disabled=i===0; next.disabled=i===pages.length-1}
prev.onclick=()=>{if(i>0){i--;show()}}; next.onclick=()=>{if(i<pages.length-1){i++;show()}}; document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowLeft')prev.click(); if(e.key==='ArrowRight')next.click()}); show();
</script></body></html>
